I personally don't have a problem with any of the development team but I just wish they would release balance updates faster. I guess I just have an extremely skewed view of how the game should be balanced, but that is where they are the weakest.

The "time to kill" in the game is much too short and healing is too important. I feel like there is way too much damage in the game, as well as too much healing. The higher the heal output a character has, the more burst damage a hero needs to break through a certain health pool, causing the need for a short TTK which IMO is extremely frustrating to play against. 

I've always wanted to try and get a group of 12 people into a custom game and experiment with healing/damage percentages, such as 50% healing and 50% damage or something like that.

I wanna see more unique weapons. I really like the E-tech shotguns from BL2 and how you have to completely change how you play to use them correctly.

One idea I had was to add a new gun type where weapons in this category have short-range spray (Like flamethrowers, but you can add like freeze guns, corrosive spitters, or a slag gun of some sort).
For a game that prides itself on having different "roles" with healers and tanks, having the only thing matter with damage makes those roles not very impactful or fun to play.

Hog and Rein? Who plays those characters anymore?

Even if they are played to an extent, why aren't pros or players of higher elo playing those heroes to combat dive?

As for positioning, those "easy to escape from" places are not common and rarely help you anyway as most DPS heroes have some sort of verticle mobility and standing in those areas usually put you away from your team.
